fairness_contract: goal desc = C1 central 2x2 block; obs map = C1 2x2-neighbourhood pooling; position = C1 peak + 3x3 subpixel centroid + margin suppression; PQ = learnable query/value projection (identity init reduces to C1 exactly, verified 1.2e-7); CA = attention-weight map replaces the cosine map; score = map peak (C1 semantics)
loss: map-level: in-view Gaussian blob (sigma 1.5 cells) at true cell; out-of-view all-low. PQ: MSE on cosine map [-1,1]; CA: BCE on pre-softmax logits
